title: Smallcap dividend stars: 5 stocks under  ₹100 with high dividend yield - Jagran Prakashan, Radiant Cash, and more | Stock Market News
text:
Small cap dividend stars: Jagran Prakashan, IL &FS Investment Managers, Radiant Cash Management, and Gateway Distriparks are among top small cap stocks under ₹100 with attractive dividend yield.

These companies trade below ₹100 apiece and offer comparatively high dividend income to shareholders. Which means that these stocks offer a relatively high annual dividend compared with their share prices. For investors who closely track stocks with high dividend yield, here are all the details to know.

Jagran Prakashan recorded an annual dividend yield of 16.1% for FY26, followed by IL&FS Investment Managers’ at 15.9%. Radiant Cash Management offered an annual yield of 7.9%, while Gateway Distriparks has an annual dividend yield of 7.6%, and Balmer Lawrie Investments stock’s dividend yield stood at 6.8%.

Jagran Prakashan share price closed 1.89% lower at ₹63.38 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of ₹1,379.49 crore on Friday. Its share price value has surged 4.57% in one month, but has declined 9.37% in one year, and 23.93% in two years.

IL & FS Investment Managers stock closed 0.13% lower at ₹7.98 per share on NSE on Friday. The stock has surged 5.28% in one month, but declined 12.42% in one year.

The stock closed 0.89% lower at ₹46.99 per share on BSE with an Mcap of ₹2,347.83 crore on Friday. Its share price value has declined 4.22% lower over the past month. The stock has delivered negative 22.21% return in one year,and around negative 43.79% return in two years.

Shares of Radiant Cash Management stock closed 0.15% lower at ₹33.20 per share on BSE on Friday. The stock has declined 2.12% in one week, 3.21% in three months, and around 18.81% in six months.

Shares of Balmer Lawrie Investments ended 0.77% lower at ₹65.45 per share on BSE with an Mcap of ₹1,452.81 crore. The stock has surged 1.44% in one month, but declined 10.60% in six months, and 13% in one year.
